expert_term.en: forensic expert engaged by a party or appointed by the investigating judge or court

appointment.basis: КПК України ст. 242 ч. 1, ст. 243 ч. 1, ст. 244
appointment.summary_en: An examination is carried out by an expert institution or expert(s) engaged by a party to the criminal proceedings, or by the investigating judge on a motion of the defence under art. 244, where special knowledge is needed (art. 242(1)). The expert is engaged on the instruction of a party (art. 243(1)); the defence may engage experts independently on a contractual basis; the investigating judge may engage an expert at the defence's request under art. 244. Art. 242(2) lists mandatory examinations (cause of death, injuries, mental state, age, damage).

questions.basis: КПК України ст. 101 ч. 1 і 4; ст. 69 ч. 4; ст. 102 ч. 3
questions.summary_en: Questions are put by the person who engaged the expert or by the investigating judge or court that ordered the examination (art. 101(1)). Questions and the opinion may not go beyond the expert's special knowledge (art. 101(4)). The expert may decline to give an opinion if the materials provided are insufficient; the refusal must be reasoned (art. 69(4)). If information relevant to the proceedings is found on which no questions were asked, the expert may state it in the opinion (art. 102(3)).

rights_duties.summary_en: An expert is a person with special knowledge entitled under the Law on Forensic Examination to perform examinations (art. 69(1)). Persons in service or other dependence on the parties or the victim cannot be experts (art. 69(2)). The expert may not collect materials on his own initiative and may refuse if materials are insufficient, with reasons (art. 69(4)); must conduct a complete study, give a reasoned opinion, appear in court, preserve the object and not disclose information (art. 69(5)); must notify the instructing person if the examination cannot be performed (art. 69). For a knowingly false opinion, refusal without good reason to perform duties in court and non-performance of other duties the expert bears liability established by law (art. 70).

appointment.basis: ЦПК України ст. 102 ч. 3, ст. 103, ст. 106
appointment.summary_en: An expert opinion may be prepared at the request of a party or on the basis of a court ruling appointing an examination (art. 102(3)). The court appoints an examination where special knowledge is needed (art. 103). A party may file an opinion prepared at its own request; it must state that it was prepared for submission to court and that the expert is aware of criminal liability for a knowingly false opinion; such an expert has the same rights and duties as a court-appointed expert (art. 106).

questions.basis: ЦПК України ст. 103; ст. 102 ч. 2 і 8; ст. 72
questions.summary_en: For a court-appointed examination the questions are determined by the court; parties may propose questions and the court must give reasons for rejecting or changing them (art. 103). The subject of an opinion may only be circumstances within the subject of proof requiring special knowledge; questions of law may not be the subject (art. 102(2)). A court-appointed expert may refuse if the materials provided are insufficient (art. 72). The expert may include his views on relevant circumstances on which no questions were asked (art. 102(8)).

rights_duties.summary_en: The expert must give a reasoned and objective written opinion, appear when summoned and explain the opinion; may not delegate the examination to another person; a court-appointed expert may refuse if the materials provided are insufficient.

appointment.basis: Господарський процесуальний кодекс України ст. 69, ст. 98, ст. 101
appointment.summary_en: An expert may be appointed by the commercial court or engaged by a party (art. 69). A party may file an opinion prepared at its own request under the forensic examination legislation; it must state that it was prepared for submission to court and that the expert is aware of criminal liability for a knowingly false opinion (art. 101).

questions.summary_en: Questions of law may not be the subject of an opinion (art. 98). A court-appointed expert may refuse if the materials provided are insufficient, with a reasoned statement; the expert may include facts found on which no questions were asked (art. 69, art. 98).

rights_duties.summary_en: The expert must give a reasoned and objective written opinion, appear when summoned (videoconference possible if parties do not object), may not delegate; may study the case file, request additional materials, include facts not asked about, attend procedural actions, and exercise rights under the Law on Forensic Examination.

statute.title_en: Law of Ukraine on Forensic Examination No. 4038-XII of 25 February 1994

liability.norm: ЦПК України ст. 102 ч. 7; ст. 106 ч. 5
liability.summary_en: A party-commissioned opinion records the expert's awareness of criminal liability for a knowingly false opinion. Article 102(7) additionally requires a refusal-of-duties warning for an examination appointed by the court. Select the wording for the actual appointment; a software export is not itself an expert opinion.
liability.warning_local: Обізнаний про кримінальну відповідальність за завідомо неправдивий висновок.
liability.warning_en: I am aware of criminal liability for a knowingly false opinion.

liability.summary_en: The criminal-procedure opinion must record that the expert was warned about liability for a knowingly false opinion and unjustified refusal to perform assigned duties. Complete this statement only after the required warning has actually occurred.
liability.warning_local: Попереджений про відповідальність за завідомо неправдивий висновок та відмову без поважних причин від виконання покладених на мене обов’язків.
liability.warning_en: I have been warned about liability for a knowingly false opinion and for refusing without good reason to perform my assigned duties.

declaration.scope: Party-commissioned opinion under Civil Procedure Code Article 106(5); not a substitute for the additional court-appointment warning under Article 102(7).

declaration.text_en: This opinion was prepared for submission to court. I am aware of criminal liability for a knowingly false opinion.

esignature.law_en: Law of Ukraine on Electronic Identification and Electronic Trust Services No. 2155-VIII, Article 18(5)-(7): electronic form alone does not invalidate a signature; a qualified electronic signature has the legal effect of a handwritten signature.

timestamp.qualified_recognition: A qualified electronic time stamp carries presumptions of accurate date/time and integrity of the associated data. Qualification depends on the provider and statutory requirements, not merely the use of RFC 3161.
